style: anime cel-shaded cinematic, Zenless Zone Zero inspired character rendering, clean line art, soft rim light, rich color grading, 16:9, smooth camera motion, high detail, consistent character design
negative: photorealistic, live action, 3D render plastic look, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, blurry, low resolution, flicker, frame jitter

characters.Erin: Erin, young female mage scribe, shoulder-length silver-lilac hair, violet eyes, deep purple hooded coat with gold trim, leather satchel of scrolls, carved wooden staff with a glowing violet orb
characters.Player: the hero seen from behind or in silhouette, hooded traveler cloak, face never shown
characters.Laoyan: Laoyan, elderly bell keeper of the fire village, white hair and long white beard, red work robe, leaning on a wooden walking staff
characters.Xiaotie: Xiaotie, energetic teenage miner boy, spiky brown hair, red headband, orange goggles on forehead, soot on cheek, brown apron
characters.Cui: Cui, elderly elf woman, long pale-green white hair, green robe with leaf ornaments, calm wise eyes
characters.Xiaoye: Xiaoye, small elf child, green twin tails, yellow tunic, holding a wooden story tablet
characters.Haido: Haido, young sea captain, dark navy short hair, white captain cap, blue naval coat with gold anchor pin
characters.Nagi: Nagi, gentle young woman, short wine-red hair, pink dress with white apron, small gold earring, holding a lantern
characters.Mio: Mio, ghostly singer of the old ship, translucent pale blue figure, long flowing hair, soft glowing outline
characters.Golem: the Lava Colossus, a 3-meter golem of cracked black basalt with glowing orange magma veins, a black crystal lodged in its chest
characters.TreeKing: the Corrupted Tree King, a towering tree creature with twisted bark limbs, glowing purple spores, a black crystal binding its heart
characters.Kraken: the Abyssal Kraken, a colossal sea monster with deep teal skin, glowing cyan runes, huge tentacles, a black crystal engraved with names on its chest

videos.title: 序章：晨鐘啞了
videos.play: 第一次進入故事地圖時（約 40 秒）

shots.zh: 清晨的火山村落全景，灰燼像雪一樣落下，鐘樓上的大鐘靜止不動。
shots.prompt: wide establishing shot of a volcanic mountain village at dawn, ash falling like snow, an old stone bell tower with a large bronze bell hanging still, warm orange sky, slow push-in

shots.zh: 鐘樓內部特寫：鐘舌斷了一截，鐘身爬著黑色結晶。
shots.prompt: close-up inside the bell tower, the bronze bell's clapper is broken in half, creeping black crystal veins on the bell surface, dust in light beams, slow orbit

shots.zh: 老焰站在空蕩的廣場，拄杖抬頭望著不響的鐘。
shots.prompt: {Laoyan} standing alone in an empty village square, looking up at the silent bell tower, ash drifting, melancholic, medium shot, gentle wind in his beard

shots.zh: 旅人（玩家背影）走上村口石階，斗篷被風吹起。
shots.prompt: {Player} walking up stone steps toward the village gate, cloak billowing in hot wind, camera behind at shoulder height, embers floating

shots.zh: 艾琳從書卷中抬頭，對旅人微笑，法杖寶珠亮起。
shots.prompt: {Erin} looks up from an open scroll and smiles at the viewer, her staff orb lights up with violet glow, medium close-up, soft rim light

shots.zh: 遠方山腹裂縫透出紅光，傳來三下敲擊聲（畫面隨聲音震一下）。
shots.prompt: distant volcano flank with a glowing red fissure, rocks tremble three times, camera shakes slightly, ominous, wide shot

shots.zh: 三座鐘的剪影依序亮起：火山、森林、海港（伏筆），最後熄滅。
shots.prompt: three bell silhouettes light up one after another over a volcano, a misty forest and a seaside harbor, then fade to darkness, mystical, symbolic montage

shots.zh: 艾琳與旅人並肩走向冒煙的礦坑口，標題浮現前的空鏡。
shots.prompt: {Erin} and {Player} walking side by side toward a smoking mine entrance, backs to camera, sunrise behind the volcano, epic wide shot, leave empty space at top for a title

videos.title: 第一章終：熔岩巨像・守門人的拳
videos.play: 1-4 開打前（約 30 秒）與通關後（約 20 秒），可拆成兩段

shots.zh: 熔岩大廳，巨像守在石閘前，胸口黑晶脈動。
shots.prompt: {Golem} guarding a massive stone gate in a magma hall, the black crystal in its chest pulsing, low angle hero shot, lava rivers glowing

shots.zh: 巨像眼睛亮起，低聲說「封住……所有的路」，熔岩從身上流下。
shots.prompt: close-up of {Golem}'s face, eyes ignite bright orange, magma drips from its jaw, slow menacing turn toward camera

shots.zh: 艾琳舉杖擋在前方，喊「攔住牠！」，旅人拔劍。
shots.prompt: {Erin} raises her staff defensively, violet barrier sparks, {Player} draws a weapon beside her, dynamic low angle, heat haze

shots.zh: 巨像高舉雙拳砸地，衝擊波捲起火星。
shots.prompt: {Golem} raises both fists and slams the ground, a ring shockwave of embers and molten rock bursts outward, camera shake, slow motion

shots.zh: （通關）黑晶碎裂，巨像緩緩跪下，熔岩轉暗。
shots.prompt: the black crystal in {Golem}'s chest shatters into glowing shards, the colossus slowly kneels, its magma veins dim to soft orange, emotional, slow motion

shots.zh: 艾琳把鐘舌扣回大鐘，鐘聲響起，金色聲波掃過整座山。
shots.prompt: {Erin} fits the broken clapper back into the great bell, the bell rings, golden sound waves sweep across the volcano and village, triumphant sunrise

videos.title: 第二章終：腐化樹王・不肯入睡的心

shots.zh: 霧中的記名林，古樹上掛著無數刻名木牌。
shots.prompt: a misty ancient forest where countless small wooden name tags hang from giant trees, soft green light rays, quiet and sacred, slow dolly forward

shots.zh: 樹王從祭壇的根中站起，紫色孢子飄散。
shots.prompt: {TreeKing} rises from tangled roots around a stone altar, purple glowing spores drift, ominous low angle, fog

shots.zh: 翠與小葉抱著名冊站在後方，艾琳回頭點頭。
shots.prompt: {Cui} and {Xiaoye} holding a large book of names behind the heroes, {Erin} glances back and nods reassuringly, medium shot, dappled light

shots.zh: 藤鞭橫掃過來，旅人蹲下閃過。
shots.prompt: a massive vine whip sweeps horizontally toward camera, {Player} ducks low under it, leaves scatter, slow motion action

shots.zh: （通關）黑晶裂開，樹根展平，一顆發光的種子落在名冊上。
shots.prompt: the black crystal binding {TreeKing}'s heart cracks open, roots relax and flatten, a single glowing seed falls gently onto an open book of names, peaceful, golden light

videos.title: 終章：深海巨妖・黎明的三重奏

shots.zh: 暴風夜的港口，舊燈塔的光在雨中掃過。
shots.prompt: stormy night harbor, an old lighthouse beam sweeping through heavy rain, waves crashing on rocks, cinematic wide shot

shots.zh: 巨妖攀上礁石，胸前刻滿名字的黑晶發光。
shots.prompt: {Kraken} climbs onto the reef, tentacles coiling around rocks, the name-engraved black crystal on its chest glowing, lightning flash, low angle

shots.zh: 海斗與凪在燈塔下，凪提燈、海斗拔出佩劍。
shots.prompt: {Haido} draws his sword and {Nagi} raises a lantern at the foot of the lighthouse, rain streaming, determined expressions, medium shot

shots.zh: 澪的幽影浮現在浪上，輕聲唱歌，歌聲化成光點。
shots.prompt: {Mio} appears hovering above the waves, singing softly, her voice turns into drifting points of light, ethereal, slow orbit

shots.zh: （結局）黑晶崩散，巨妖沉回深海，雨停。
shots.prompt: the black crystal on {Kraken}'s chest crumbles to sparkling dust, the giant sinks back into the deep sea, the rain stops, clouds part, calm

shots.zh: 三座鐘隔著山、林、海同時響起，晨光灑落。
shots.prompt: split-screen montage of three bells ringing at once on a volcano, in a forest and at a harbor, golden dawn light washing over all three, triumphant

shots.zh: 白帆船化成晨光遠去；港口立起歸航者名碑。
shots.prompt: a ghostly white-sailed ship dissolves into morning light on the horizon, villagers gather around a new memorial stone of names at the harbor, emotional wide shot

shots.zh: 艾琳合上紀行，對旅人微笑（片尾）。
shots.prompt: {Erin} closes a leather-bound travel journal and smiles warmly at the viewer, sunrise behind her, soft focus, ending shot
